correct_answer_text: Implement RAG grounded in source documents with citations
rationale: Grounding responses in retrieved source content (and citing it) is the correct fix for hallucination; raising temperature would worsen it.

rationale: Semantic Kernel orchestrates models, tools/plugins and memory to build AI apps and agents in code.

correct_answer_text: Select from multiple foundation models (GPT, Llama, Phi, etc.)
rationale: 'Bring your own model' lets customers pick the best/most cost-effective model per use case instead of being locked to one.

correct_answer_text: Small, independently deployable services communicating over APIs
rationale: Microservices decompose an app into independently deployable, API-connected services, enabling independent scaling and release.

correct_answer_text: Producers emit events consumers react to asynchronously
rationale: Event-driven systems decouple producers and consumers via asynchronous events, improving scalability and resilience.

correct_answer_text: Noun-based URLs, correct status codes, and versioning
rationale: RESTful design uses resource nouns, meaningful HTTP status codes, authentication and versioning - not verbs-in-URLs or blanket 200s.

correct_answer_text: The app plus dependencies and runtime, isolated from the host
rationale: A container bundles the app with its dependencies/runtime and shares the host kernel - lighter than a full VM - giving consistent, portable execution.

correct_answer_text: Azure Container Apps (ACA) - serverless containers
rationale: ACA runs containers serverlessly without exposing Kubernetes control planes/nodes, ideal for microservices without cluster management.

correct_answer_text: Assess -> upgrade to modern .NET -> containerise -> deploy

correct_answer_text: A fully managed PaaS for web apps and APIs

correct_answer_text: A managed PaaS web app or serverless container
rationale: For a simple stateless API with low ops overhead, managed PaaS/serverless is the right first choice over self-managed clusters or VMs.

correct_answer_text: Automate building, testing and deploying code reliably
rationale: CI/CD automates build, test and deploy so changes ship frequently and safely with less manual error.
